Form field that opens one of the `color-*` picker style variants (sketch/chrome/compact/
github/material, chosen via `colorType`) in a popup, and binds the selected hex value to
the form control.

exports.name: MatCheckGroup
exports.summary: A group of radio buttons. May contain one or more `<mat-radio-button>` elements.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the radio button group. All radio buttons inside this group will use this name.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Alignment of the radio-buttons relative to their labels. Can be 'before' or 'after'.

inputs.name: labelPosition
inputs.description: Whether the labels should appear after or before the radio-buttons. Defaults to 'after'

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Whether the radio group is disabled

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether the radio group is required

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: Whether the radio button is selected.

outputs.name: change
outputs.description:
Event emitted when the group value changes.
Change events are only emitted when the value changes due to user interaction with
a radio button (the same behavior as `<input type-"radio">`).

properties.name: invalidText
properties.default: 'The value in this field is invalid'

properties.name: defaultOptions
properties.default:
{
    hideFieldUnderline: true,
    floatLabel: 'always',
    hideLabel: true,
    color: 'accent',
    defaultValue: false
  }
